analyst_view.overall: Shakhtar (24th, 4 points) host Fenerbahce (22nd, 5 points) at Stamford Bridge in London because of the war, so there is little real home advantage, and both need points to stay in play-off contention. It is the first Champions League meeting of two Turkish head coaches, Arda Turan and Emre Belozoglu, who took over Fenerbahce on 3 November and is in his first Champions League game; Fenerbahce have not won away in this competition in 13 tries. Shakhtar are winless in three and miss Pedrinho, Gleiker Mendoza, Kaua Elias, Eguinaldo and Marlon Santos, all counted, and are expected to start Alisson Santana, Marlon Gomes, Newertton and Luca Meirelles in attack. Fenerbahce's 22-man squad is without only Ake and Asensio (counted); Turkish reports have Kante back alongside Guendouzi and Muriqi starting ahead of Lukaku, with Greenwood on the wing. English referee Michael Oliver (about 4 cards a game) is named and already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals (0.8 Shakhtar, 1.6 Fenerbahce), already cutting Shakhtar hard for Pedrinho and Mendoza and taking Asensio and Ake into account for Fenerbahce. Today's squad news only confirms those absences, and Muriqi for Lukaku changes who scores more than how many, so I stay at 2.4.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners, 5.3 for Shakhtar, already lifted for their recent corner run and cut for Fenerbahce's. A near-neutral venue and an open game with both sides needing points fit that figure, so I stay at 9.2.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.8 cards, the highest of tonight's games, with Michael Oliver's close-to-average record barely moving them. Turan has asked for aggression and energy and both sides need the points, but that busy-game picture is already in both teams' card records, so I stay at 4.8.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.3 shots, lifted 15% for Shakhtar's recent shooting and cut 9% for Fenerbahce's quieter run. Kante's return should give Fenerbahce more control and Muriqi is a target man rather than a volume shooter, which changes the style more than the count, so I stay at 26.3.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.8 on target, almost even between the sides. Shakhtar lack their main finishers, which the numbers count through goals, and Fenerbahce's expected side with Greenwood and Muriqi is close to their usual one, so I stay at 8.8.
